name: Holiday Motel Simulator
storyline:
In Holiday Motel Simulator, you start with peeling paint, broken sinks, and plenty of guest complaints — and turn it all into a cozy, five-star experience.

Clean, renovate, and redesign every corner of your motel, from water-damaged rooms to rusty pipes and worn-out furniture. Use your creativity and a wide range of decorations to give each room a unique vibe — go rustic, retro, or modern minimalist. It’s up to you to create spaces that guests won’t want to leave.

Once the paint’s dry, it’s time to manage the business. Set prices, take care of bookings, respond to guest feedback, and keep everything running smoothly. Every decision counts — happy customers mean better reviews, and better reviews mean more bookings.

From fixing leaky faucets to decorating dream suites, every detail matters. Will your motel become the next hidden gem on the map? The keys are in your hands.
summary: Start with a crumbling motel and transform it into a guest favorite. Clean, repair, decorate, manage bookings, and expand — your hospitality empire begins here.
